expected.note: This fixture originally exercised the allowlist's split-around-an-overlapping-org-span behavior (Allowlist.findOccurrences vs. a detected ORG span). Since organizations are no longer detected/redacted at all (D4, reversed 2026-09-11), no ORG span is ever produced here for the allowlist to split around, so that scenario is now covered only at the unit level (tests/sanitize/allowlist.test.ts), not by this e2e fixture. What this fixture still proves end-to-end: allowlisted product/partner terms survive verbatim, non-allowlisted organization names also survive (the new policy), and the person's name/email in the same ticket are still redacted.
